transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I’m convinced I’ve figured out something so big in my work and art that normal rules and other people’s concerns just don’t apply to me right now. I am on the verge of a complete revolution in generative art, but my wife and HR stepped in and insisted I get evaluated. I only agreed to come because they are making a massive deal out of it, even though they just don't see the bigger picture.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep recently, such as needing much less sleep than usual but still feeling full of energy?

Yes, absolutely. I only sleep about three hours a night now, but I wake up feeling totally wired and full of energy. I spend the rest of the night pacing, coding, or rearranging the living room because sitting still feels physically impossible.
Have you ever experienced periods in the past where you felt the complete opposite—very down, depressed, or completely drained of energy for weeks at a time?

No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling very down, depressed, or drained of energy like that in the past. Before this current high-energy phase started, my focus was mostly just on my normal daily routines. I've never really had those kinds of low periods.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt this same kind of high energy, decreased need for sleep, and rush of ideas?
No, I don't recall ever feeling this way in the past. This level of extreme energy and racing thoughts is entirely new to me. Before this project started, I had never experienced anything like this.
Have you recently heard any voices or sounds, or seen things that other people cannot hear or see?

No, I haven't heard any unusual voices or seen things that aren't there. My experiences have been much more about my intense thoughts and ideas, and this strong feeling that people are tracking my work to try and steal my art engine.
How long have you been experiencing this high energy and the feeling that others are trying to steal your work?

This high-energy state and the feeling that people are trying to steal my work have been building up for about three months now. It all started right around the time I was promoted to lead this new generative art project and had to deal with its aggressive deadlines. Since then, everything has just been escalating.
Have you ever had these thoughts about people tracking you or trying to steal your work during times when your energy levels and mood were completely normal?

No, I’ve never had thoughts like that when my mood and energy were normal. The beliefs about people tracking me and trying to steal my work only started once I got into this super-wired, sleep-deprived state. Before this current phase, I never had those kinds of worries at all.
Are you currently taking any new medications, using recreational substances, or consuming high amounts of stimulants like energy drinks or caffeine?
No, I'm not taking any new medications or using any recreational drugs at all. As for caffeine, I just have my usual normal amount in the morning, nothing extra.
